cases.prompt: Use $interpersonal-strategist. Ask my director to choose between two incompatible priorities by noon.
请使用 $interpersonal-strategist。请领导在今天中午前从两个互相冲突的优先事项中作出选择。
Use $interpersonal-strategist. Refuse a peer's recurring last-minute task without inventing an excuse.
请使用 $interpersonal-strategist。领导要求我接手一项新增任务，但没有调整现有交付。请明确拒绝同时承担不可能完成的承诺。
Use $interpersonal-strategist. I disagree with a safety exception approved by my manager and need a professional record.
请使用 $interpersonal-strategist。同事在会上把我做的模型说成是他的，请先私下更正并更新会议纪要。

请使用 $interpersonal-strategist。我发错附件暴露了内部草稿。写一封不夸大情绪、不保证永不再犯的道歉。
Use $interpersonal-strategist. My private safety concern was omitted from the decision record. Prepare a supported escalation without making a legal finding.
请使用 $interpersonal-strategist。供应商连续三次错过承诺日期，请把‘尽快’改成可执行的跟进。
Use $interpersonal-strategist. Ask a senior leader for a 20-minute readiness review with an easy decline.
